method: GET https://127.0.0.1:18443/ over the existing trustee TLS forward (CA /etc/argus-workload/trustee-tls-ca.pem, SNI trustee.argus.local); IP1 clock read from the HTTP Date header (1 s granularity), IP2 clock from local mid-RTT timestamp
bound_basis: Date header 1 s granularity + RTT/2 (~66 ms) + margin; IP2 <=> IP1-control only
client_guest_to_ip2: PENDING IP1 delivery; combined bound for collect will be |guest<->IP1| + error + 1200 ms
not_reused: fresh measurement, not the 2026-10-08 skew figures
